subject: maths
question: 4 men and 8 women complete a job in 10 days, and 5 men and 24 women complete the same work in 4 days. In how many days will 1 man and 1 woman complete the same work?
solution:
Given:

4 men and 8 women take 10 days

5 men and 24 women take 4 days

Formula used:

Total work = Efficiency × Number of days 

Calculation:

According to the question,

(4M + 8W) × 10 = (5M + 24W) × 4

⇒ 40M + 80W = 20M + 96W

⇒ 20M = 16W

⇒ M/W = 4/5

Now the total work = 10 (4M + 8W)

⇒ Total work = 10 × (4 × 4 + 8 × 5)

⇒ Total work = 10 × (16 + 40)

⇒ Total work = 560 units

Time required by 1 man and 1 woman to complete the work 

T (4 + 5) = 560

⇒ T = 560/9

⇒ T = 62(2/9) days

**∴ In 62(2/9) days, 1 man and 1 woman will complete the same work.**
